name: mentha piperita leaf
purpose: DIRECTIONS OF SAFE USE: Wash your hands before using eye drops, and tilt your head back or lie flat as much as possible. Pull down the lower eyelid and separate it from the eyeball, and drop the eye drops into the lower conjunctival fornix. Close your eyes for at least five minutes, or gently massage the upper and lower tear ducts at the inner corner of the eye with your fingers. Use a tissue or towel to wipe off the drops and tears that have flowed out of the eye.
uses: Relieve eye fatigue; maintain overall eye comfort; promote vision recovery; make vision clearer and more comfortableensitivity.
otcwarn: Please keep out of reach of children. Do not swallow.Please clean your hands before use to ensure the best results from the product. Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur. Store in a cool and dry place.
